mapper.insert: INSERT INTO universe (task_id, universe_index, product_name, target_market, rating, sub_state, evolution_data, survival_rate, strategy_package, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{universeIndex}, #{productName}, #{targetMarket}, #{rating, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subState, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evolutionData, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{survivalRate, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{strategyPackage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{traceId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE universe SET rating = #{rating}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, universe_index, product_name, target_market, rating, sub_state, evolution_data, survival_rate, strategy_package, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM universe WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY universe_index
